items.title: Virginia regulators start Dominion-NextEra merger hearing
items.summary: Virginia regulators began formal hearings Tuesday to decide whether to approve a $67 billion merger proposal between Dominion Energy and NextEra Energy that would create the world’s largest regulated electric utility. The State Corporation Commission, which regulates utilities in Virginia and is the state decision-maker on the proposal, is hearing the case this week. The process kicked off ...
